sls_cfg_distance_scale_desc: Distance from the center increases creature levels. Each distance ring can increase creature levels further. By default Ashlands and Deep North are significantly less impacted from this for balance.
sls_cfg_distance_overlay_toggle: Show distance rings on the map
sls_cfg_nomap_ring_toggle: Show ring level when playing without a map
sls_cfg_zone_scale_desc: The world is split into zones, each zone track kills and levels up, causing higher level spawns. Over time zones levels decay.
sls_cfg_zone_overlay_toggle: Show zone overlay on the map
sls_cfg_nomap_zone_toggle: Show zone level when playing without a map
sls_cfg_conditional_scale_desc: Defeating bosses causes previous biomes to increase in difficulty. This helps to keep a more equal level of challenge between all biomes, and also provides higher rewards when returning to old biomes.
sls_cfg_scaling_intro: Choose which systems push creature levels up as you play. They stack, so a creature far from the center, in a hard-fought area, late in your progression can get all three.
sls_cfg_conditional_scale_note: While on, the latest defeated boss's tier replaces the default level chances (next page) in the biomes it covers.
sls_cfg_welcome_title: Thanks for playing with Star Level System!
sls_cfg_welcome_intro: This short setup walks through the main options so your world plays the way you want. A few things the mod can do:
sls_cfg_welcome_bullet_levels: Creatures can spawn with many more stars, gaining health, damage and size with each one.
sls_cfg_welcome_bullet_scaling: Levels can rise with distance from the world center, with fighting in an area, and with each boss you defeat.
sls_cfg_welcome_bullet_modifiers: Modifiers such as Fire, Frost, Summoner or Splitter give creatures new abilities, shown in their names and star icons.
sls_cfg_welcome_bullet_raids: Raids are tailored to each player's progress, and several can run at once.
sls_cfg_welcome_bullet_nemesis: The Nemesis system watches how you fight, raising the challenge when you dominate and easing off when you struggle.
sls_cfg_welcome_bullet_loot: Loot, colors and sizes can all scale with a creature's level.
sls_cfg_welcome_skip: Already set things up the way you like? Click the X in the top right corner and this setup won't appear again.
sls_cfg_welcome_later: You can save from any page. Reopen these settings later with the Mod Config button on the main menu, or on the pause menu when you host or are an admin.
sls_cfg_welcome_server: Joining someone else's server? Their settings apply there; this only changes worlds you host. Many more options live in the YAML files under BepInEx/config/StarLevelSystem.
sls_cfg_distribution_intro: Pick the star range new creatures spawn in and how quickly the chances fall off toward the top. The chart updates as you go.
sls_cfg_distribution_caption: Chance of each star level for a new spawn, before distance, zone and night bonuses.
sls_cfg_raids_intro: StarLevelSystem replaces vanilla raids with its own. Open a raid's spawns to set how many of each creature arrive per wave, how many may be alive at once (0 stops that creature spawning), and the seconds between its waves. Spawn chances, levels and activation keys live in RaidSettings.yaml.
sls_cfg_night_spawns_intro: Each boss you defeat lets new creatures roam the world at night. Untick a boss to stop the night spawns it unlocks; any already out still leave at dawn, and nothing else the boss unlocks changes.
sls_cfg_distribution_caps_below_min: Some biome caps are below Min stars; creatures in those biomes stay at their biome's cap.
sls_cfg_distribution_conditional_note: Conditional scaling is on: once a boss is defeated, its tier replaces these chances in the biomes it covers.
sls_cfg_distribution_merge_note: LevelSettings.yaml builds the default curve from several generators; saving a change here replaces them with the single curve shown.
sls_cfg_nemesis_intro: The Nemesis system is a game master that follows each player. It watches how you fight (damage dealt and taken, deaths and boss kills) and keeps a hidden score that always drifts back toward neutral. Dominate, and it raises creature levels, sends themed ambushes, and can bring back a creature that killed you as a named nemesis. Struggle or keep dying, and it quietly lowers the level of new spawns until things feel fair again. Every action it takes nudges the score back toward neutral.
sls_cfg_nemesis_score_help: The score rises as you deal damage and kill bosses, and falls when you take damage or die. Each update it moves toward Neutral by the decay amount. Actions fire once the score passes their threshold: thresholds above Neutral make things harder, below Neutral easier.
sls_cfg_nemesis_actions_help: Actions are checked in this order as creatures spawn near you. The first one that passes its threshold and chance fires, then every action waits for the cooldown.
sls_cfg_nemesis_score_order: Nemesis scores must be ordered Min <= Neutral <= Max before they can be saved.
sls_cfg_discard_body: Some changes on these pages have not been saved yet.
sls_cfg_welcome_bullet_resets: Looted dungeons, locations, ore and pickables can come back on a timer with Location Reset, once you turn it on.
sls_cfg_locreset_about: Location Reset brings looted dungeons, locations, ore and pickables back on a timer, in the background and away from players. Player builds, wards, tombstones, portals, beds, chests and tames hold back what stands near them. Back up your world before turning it on.
sls_cfg_locreset_conflict: A conflicting location reset mod is installed, so Location Reset stays off whatever is set here.
sls_cfg_locreset_switch_mismatch: EnableLocationReset and the Enabled flag in LocationResetSettings.yaml disagree, so nothing resets. This switch sets both.
sls_cfg_locreset_stamp_hint: On an already-explored world every zone timer starts from the moment you turn this on, so nothing resets at once. Use sls-loc-stamp to re-baseline later.
sls_cfg_locreset_settings_notes: Starting timers on first visit keeps a newly seen zone from resetting straight away. Ore and vegetation wait for players beyond the safe radius and builds beyond the protection radius; locations use the location player radius and buffer. Refilled chests re-roll their loot. A sweep budget of 0 uses the YAML Throughput value.
sls_cfg_locreset_biome_help: Multiplies every timer in a biome: 0.5 resets twice as fast, 2 half as fast, and 0 never resets there. Cron schedules ignore rates.
sls_cfg_locreset_groups_help: Each group turns a set of targets on and sets how often they come back. Members, schedules and distance limits are edited in LocationResetSettings.yaml; sls-loc-status shows what each group matched.
sls_cfg_loot_intro: How much more a creature drops for every star it has, and the same for trees, rocks, destructibles and birds. The estimate on the right works these numbers through a real drop table at no stars and at Max stars, so you can see what a change is worth before saving it.
sls_cfg_loot_objects_help: Each of these adds its share of an object's vanilla drop table per level: 0.5 means a 5-level tree drops about 3.5x the wood.
sls_cfg_loot_rings_help: Each ring adds to the loot scaling for a kill inside it, on top of the per-star numbers above. Min and Max are the ends of the amount roll; Chance is added to the per-level drop chance ramp. A kill further out than the last ring falls outside them all and gets no bonus.
sls_cfg_loot_no_rings: No loot rings are configured, so this grants nothing until one is added.
sls_cfg_rings_intro: Past each ring's distance from the world center, creatures get extra level-up chance on top of the curve from the Level Distribution page. The furthest ring a spawn is past is the one that counts. These are the rings drawn on the map.
sls_cfg_rings_help: Each value adds percentage points to the chance of reaching the next star: the first to 1 star, the second to 2 stars, and so on. Tick a ring to see it on the right.
sls_cfg_rings_caption: Chance of each star level for a new spawn with no ring, then past the ticked one, before biome caps, night and zone bonuses.
sls_cfg_rings_none: No distance rings are configured, so distance adds nothing to creature levels until one is added.
sls_cfg_rings_off: Distance scaling is off on the Level Progression page, so these rings add nothing until it is turned on.
sls_cfg_rings_yaml_off: EnableDistanceLevelBonus is off in LevelSettings.yaml, so these rings add nothing until it is turned on there.
sls_cfg_reset_body: Every setting on this page goes back to the mod's default. The other pages keep their edits, and nothing is written until you Save.
sls_cfg_tip_close: Closes the panel. If anything has not been saved yet you are asked about it first.
sls_cfg_tip_back: The previous page. Moving between pages keeps your edits; only Save writes them.
sls_cfg_tip_next: The next page. Moving between pages keeps your edits; only Save writes them.
sls_cfg_tip_reset_page: Puts every setting on this page back to the mod's default. The other pages keep their edits, and nothing is written until you Save.
sls_cfg_tip_save: Writes every page's changes: the BepInEx settings and the YAML files behind them. The panel stays open.
sls_cfg_tip_finish: Saves everything and closes the panel.
sls_cfg_status_reset_done: $1 is back to its defaults. Save to keep it.
sls_cfg_dist_world_note_menu: In a world, its Combat world modifier can also change these star chances and creature sizes.
sls_cfg_dist_world_star_chances: star chances x$1 (included in the charts)
sls_cfg_dist_world_note: Combat world modifier: $1 on top of the settings here.
sls_cfg_tip_min_stars: The lowest star level a new creature can spawn with. The curve starts here, and distance bonuses no longer reach below it.
sls_cfg_tip_curve_style: How the chance falls away from Min to Max stars. Linear spreads it evenly, Exponential makes high stars rare, Gaussian favours the middle of the range, and Table uses the values you type below.
sls_cfg_tip_levelup_chance: How likely a creature is to pass the first star level, which sets how far up the curve creatures usually get. Gaussian uses it to narrow the bell instead.
sls_cfg_tip_gaussian_offset: Moves the peak of the bell curve: -1 towards Min stars, +1 towards Max stars.
sls_cfg_tip_table_thresholds: The % chance to roll past each star level, starting at Min stars. Values have to go down, and how many you enter sets Max stars.
sls_cfg_tip_night_multiplier: Multiplies these chances at night only, so creatures spawn with more stars after dark. 1 leaves them alone.
sls_cfg_tip_boss_min_stars: The lowest star level a boss can spawn with once bosses have their own curve.
sls_cfg_tip_boss_curve_style: How the boss chance falls away from Boss min to Max boss stars. Table style reads the same LevelupChanceTablesBySpan entry as any other curve of that length.
sls_cfg_tip_boss_levelup_chance: How likely a boss is to pass its first star level.
sls_cfg_tip_boss_gaussian_offset: Moves the peak of the boss bell curve: -1 towards Boss min stars, +1 towards Max boss stars.
sls_cfg_tip_boss_night_multiplier: Multiplies the boss chances at night only. 1 leaves them alone.
sls_cfg_tip_biome_cap_manual: Editable once the caps stop scaling with Max stars.
sls_cfg_table_single_level: A single star level always rolls that level; widen Min/Max stars to use a table.
sls_cfg_table_none: No table for $1 levels yet, so rolls use the Exponential curve shown. Edit these values and press Enter to save a table.
sls_cfg_table_not_decreasing: Values must decrease: each is the % chance to roll past a star level, so one at or above the value before it is never rolled.
sls_cfg_table_ok: $1-$2 stars: each value is the % chance to roll past that star level, starting at $1.
sls_cfg_table_unreadable: Could not read '$1'. Enter numbers separated by commas, e.g. 30, 15, 5, 0.01.
sls_cfg_table_too_few: Enter at least two values; a table covers two or more levels.
sls_cfg_rings_col_bonus: Extra % per star, from 1 star up
sls_cfg_tip_ring_show: Shows this ring on the right, under the same curve with no ring at all.
sls_cfg_tip_level_ring_distance: Metres from the world center (or the starter temple, see DistanceBonusIsFromStarterTemple) where this ring starts. A spawn gets the bonus of the furthest ring it is past, so each ring covers from here out to the next one. $1-$2m, and no two rings at the same distance.
sls_cfg_tip_level_ring_bonus: Percentage points added to each level-up chance past this ring: the first value to the chance of reaching 1 star, the next to 2 stars, and so on. A value past the end of the curve extends it. Where the file skips a star the ring is written as level:value pairs, level 1 being the roll to 1 star; either form can be typed. Empty adds nothing, but the ring is still drawn on the map.
sls_cfg_tip_add_ring: Adds a ring past the furthest one, as far beyond it as the last two are apart, with the same bonus. Type over its distance to move it.
sls_cfg_tip_remove_ring: Removes this ring. Nothing is written until you Save.
sls_cfg_rings_no_room: There is no room for another ring past $1 m.
sls_cfg_rings_distance_taken: There is already a ring at $1 m, so this one stays at $2 m.
sls_cfg_rings_bad_level: '$1' has to start with a level of 1 or more.
sls_cfg_rings_unreadable: Could not read '$1'. Enter percentages separated by commas, e.g. 15, 5, 1.
sls_cfg_rings_summary_none: With no rings, creatures spawn on the curve above wherever they are.
sls_cfg_rings_summary: Past $1 m, $2 of spawns have a star and the average spawn has $3, against $4 and $5 with no ring.
sls_cfg_rings_strength: Bonuses shown x$1, the All biome's distance scale.
sls_cfg_tip_loot_distance: Adds a bonus to loot scaling the further a kill is from the world center. These rings are LootSettings.yaml's own - they are not the distance rings the level system uses, and they are not drawn on the map.
sls_cfg_tip_loot_estimate: Every drop the sample creature has, at no stars and at Max stars from the Level Distribution page, near the world center; with distance loot on, a last column works the same kill inside the furthest ring. Amounts are the drop's own min-max carried through the multiplier and the world's Resources modifier - vanilla rolls that range with the top end exclusive, so the real maximum of a wide range is one step lower. A % under an amount is its chance to drop at all; the pseudo-random streak vanilla applies to drops under 30% is not modelled, so a rare drop lands a little more evenly than its number suggests.
sls_cfg_tip_add_loot_ring: Adds a ring past the furthest one, as far beyond it as the last two are apart, with the same bonuses. Type over its distance to move it.
sls_cfg_tip_loot_ring_distance: Metres from the world center this ring reaches out to. A kill is matched to the first ring that reaches it, so each ring covers from the one before it out to here. $1-$2m, and no two rings at the same distance.
sls_cfg_tip_loot_ring_min: Added to the loot scale at the low end of the roll for a kill inside this ring.
sls_cfg_tip_loot_ring_max: Added to the loot scale at the high end of the roll. Set it above Min for a wider spread out here.
sls_cfg_tip_loot_ring_chance: Added to the per-level drop chance ramp in this ring, so uncertain drops land more often out here.
sls_cfg_loot_ring_no_room: There is no room for another loot ring past $1 m.
sls_cfg_loot_ring_distance_taken: There is already a loot ring at $1 m, so this one stays at $2 m.
sls_cfg_loot_style_exponential: Exponential: a creature's drops are multiplied by (1 + $1) once per star, so late stars are worth far more than early ones. Drop chances follow the same multiplier.
sls_cfg_loot_style_chance_per_level: ChancePerLevel: amounts are multiplied by level x $1, and an uncertain drop's chance by $2 + $3 per level - so low stars can drop less often than vanilla, and high stars almost always.
sls_cfg_loot_style_per_level: PerLevel: a creature's drops are multiplied by level x $1, and an uncertain drop's chance by the same amount. Drop chance per level only reaches creatures with a table in LootSettings.yaml.
sls_cfg_loot_warn_zero: Loot per star is 0, so every creature drops its base amount at any star level.
sls_cfg_loot_warn_ceiling: At $1 this style reaches the $2x ceiling loot scaling is clamped to, so the top of the range is cut rather than earned.
sls_cfg_loot_warn_low_chance: At 0 stars this style multiplies an uncertain drop's chance by $1, so those drops are rarer than vanilla until a creature has a few stars.
sls_cfg_loot_warn_below_one: Below 1, loot per star cannot lower a drop's chance: the multiplier never falls under 1x.
sls_cfg_loot_stand_in_note: The $1 prefab is only there once a world is loaded, so these are stand-in drops. Reopen this page in game to see the $1's own table.
sls_cfg_loot_world_note_menu: In a world, its Resources world modifier also scales these amounts.
sls_cfg_loot_world_note: Resources world modifier: amounts x$1, included above. Items vanilla never scales keep theirs.
sls_cfg_stats_mp_hp_toggle: Enemies gain HP with more players
sls_cfg_stats_mp_dmg_toggle: Enemies gain dmg with more players
sls_cfg_stats_mp_off: Multiplayer scaling is off: groups face the same creatures as a solo player.
sls_cfg_stats_mp_group: With $1 or more players nearby, creatures take $2x damage (about $3x the health) and deal $4x damage.
sls_cfg_stats_mp_troll: A $2 with $1 then takes about $3 damage to kill and hits for about $4.
sls_cfg_mods_limit_to_stars: Limit modifier count to star level
sls_cfg_mod_boss_summoner: Summons minion creatures at regular intervals.
sls_cfg_mod_soul_eater: Grows stronger as nearby creatures die; self-heals.
sls_cfg_mod_life_link: Redirects some damage taken to a nearby creature.
sls_cfg_mod_splitter: Spawns replacement creatures when it dies.
sls_cfg_mod_lootbags: Tankier and faster; drops extra loot.
sls_cfg_mod_fire: Adds fire damage to its attacks.
sls_cfg_mod_frost: Adds frost damage to its attacks.
sls_cfg_mod_poison: Adds poison damage to its attacks.
sls_cfg_mod_lightning: Adds lightning damage to its attacks.
sls_cfg_mod_fire_nova: Explodes in fire on death, damaging nearby targets.
sls_cfg_mod_frost_nova: Explodes in frost on death, damaging nearby targets.
sls_cfg_mod_poison_nova: Explodes in poison on death, damaging nearby targets.
sls_cfg_mod_lightning_nova: Explodes in lightning on death, damaging nearby targets.
sls_cfg_mod_evolving: Gains a level after enough kills.
sls_cfg_mod_resist_pierce: Reduces damage taken from pierce (e.g. arrows).
sls_cfg_mod_small: Shrinks the creature and weakens its attacks; the smaller it is, the weaker it hits.
sls_cfg_mod_stamina_drain: Its attacks drain your stamina. Dodging avoids it; blocking or parrying lessens it.
sls_cfg_mod_eitr_drain: Its attacks drain your eitr. Dodging avoids it; blocking or parrying lessens it.
sls_cfg_mod_elemental_chaos: Adds random elemental damage on each hit.
sls_cfg_mod_reflection: Can send projectiles back along their arc; glancing shots deflect into others.
sls_cfg_tip_raids_enable: On, StarLevelSystem runs its own raids. Off, Valheim's own raid events are used instead and nothing on this page applies.
sls_cfg_tip_raids_pause: On, no SLS raid starts on its own; with SLS raids enabled that means no raids at all. Every raid keeps its settings, and sls-raid-spawn still starts one for testing.
sls_cfg_tip_raids_chance_multiplier: Multiplies every raid's activation chance each time it is rolled. 1 uses the chances in RaidSettings.yaml as written, 0.5 halves them and 0 means no raid ever starts on its own. Several raids are rolled each check (Max attempts / player), so at high chances one of them almost always starts. The world's Raids modifier applies on top.
sls_cfg_tip_raids_cooldown_multiplier: Multiplies how long a player waits after a raid before the next can start (each raid's RaidCoolDownMinutes). Higher means raids come less often: 2 doubles every wait, 0.5 halves it. The world's Raids modifier applies on top.
sls_cfg_tip_raids_pause_before_completed: Once a raid stops spawning, it stays active this many seconds so its creatures can be finished off. Killing them all ends it straight away. 0 ends every raid the moment it stops spawning. A raid with RaidActiveTillDefeated: true in RaidSettings.yaml waits for its creatures instead, for up to RaidActiveTillDefeatedMaxSeconds.
sls_cfg_tip_raids_density: How crowded every raid is, $1 to $2. $3 is the numbers the raids were designed with; $1 thins every raid back to roughly vanilla sized and $2 is not meant to be survivable. Moving it rewrites each creature's Each and Max alive on the right, never below 1. Numbers still as shipped are scaled from the ones the raids were designed with and numbers you changed from the file - so sliding back where you started puts the raids back exactly.
sls_cfg_raids_density_note_file: $1 - raids spawn the creature counts in RaidSettings.yaml.
sls_cfg_raids_density_note_scaled: $1 - every raid's creature counts x$2, at least 1 each.
sls_cfg_raids_world_note_menu: In a world, its Raids world modifier also applies: None stops these raids, and Less or More lengthen or shorten cooldowns and lower or raise chances.
sls_cfg_raids_world_note_off: Raids world modifier: $1 - no raid starts on its own in this world, whatever is set here.
sls_cfg_raids_world_note_normal: Raids world modifier: $1 - raids run as set here.
sls_cfg_raids_world_note: Raids world modifier: $1 - every cooldown x$2 and chance x$3 on top of the settings here.
sls_cfg_tip_raid_entry: Runs for $1s, then waits $2 minutes before it can be picked again. A disabled raid keeps all of its settings in RaidSettings.yaml.
sls_cfg_tip_raids_spawn_each: How many of this creature arrive each time the raid spawns it.
sls_cfg_tip_raids_spawn_max_alive: How many of this creature may be alive at once from this raid. 0 stops it spawning at all.
sls_cfg_tip_raids_spawn_every: Seconds between this creature's waves. The raid keeps spawning it until it hits Max alive.
sls_cfg_night_none_world: No night spawns in this world.
sls_cfg_night_vanilla_defeated_gdking: Greydwarf brutes and shamans in the Meadows, and Draugr in fog across the Meadows, Black Forest, Mountain and Plains
sls_cfg_night_vanilla_defeated_bonemass: Skeletons across the Meadows, Black Forest, Swamp, Mountain and Plains
sls_cfg_night_vanilla_defeated_goblinkin: Fulings across the Meadows, Black Forest and Mountain
sls_cfg_night_vanilla_defeated_queen: Seekers, Seeker broods and Ticks across the Meadows, Black Forest, Mountain and Plains
sls_cfg_tip_nem_cooldown: Seconds every Nemesis action waits after any one of them fires, level changes and spawns alike.
sls_cfg_tip_nem_influence: How far from you a creature can spawn and still trigger a Nemesis spawn. Level changes ignore this.
sls_cfg_tip_nem_min_spawn: Nemesis spawns are kept at least this far away, so an ambush never lands in your lap.
sls_cfg_tip_nem_neutral_score: The score everything drifts back towards. Actions with a threshold above it make the world harder, below it easier.
sls_cfg_tip_nem_min_score: The lowest the score can fall. A threshold outside the Min to Max range never fires.
sls_cfg_tip_nem_max_score: The highest the score can climb. A threshold outside the Min to Max range never fires.
sls_cfg_tip_nem_decay: How far the score moves back towards Neutral on every update, so a good or bad run fades with time.
sls_cfg_tip_nem_interval: Seconds between score recalculations. Damage dealt and taken are averaged over the last few of these.
sls_cfg_tip_nem_boss_kill: Score gained for killing a boss near you, which pushes the world towards its harder actions.
sls_cfg_tip_nem_death: Score lost when you die. A large value makes the system ease off quickly after a bad fight.
sls_cfg_tip_nem_chance: How likely this action is to fire once its score threshold is met and the cooldown is up.
sls_cfg_tip_nem_threshold: The score this action needs. Above Neutral it fires when you are at or above it, below Neutral when you are at or below it.
sls_cfg_tip_nem_level_bonus: Levels added to the creatures this action touches. Negative values take levels away.
sls_cfg_nem_effect_miniboss: Brings back a creature that killed a player as a named nemesis, with minions
sls_cfg_nem_effect_unimplemented: $1 is not implemented yet, so this never fires
sls_cfg_nem_never_fires: Never fires: the threshold is outside the score range.
sls_cfg_nem_raises_struggling: Raises levels while the player is struggling.
sls_cfg_nem_lowers_doing_well: Lowers levels while the player is doing well.
sls_cfg_tip_locreset_first_visit: The first time the sweep sees a zone it records what is there and starts its timer, rather than resetting it immediately.
sls_cfg_tip_locreset_default_hours: Real-world hours between resets for anything that does not set its own timer.
sls_cfg_tip_locreset_default_terrain: Restores the ground as well as the objects, which is what undoes mining craters and dug-out approaches.
sls_cfg_tip_locreset_safe_radius: Ore, pickables and vegetation in a zone with a player within this distance are left alone and tried again later.
sls_cfg_tip_locreset_protection_radius: How far from a chunk's centre a player build holds back its ore, pickables and vegetation. The scan covers the chunk and its neighbours, so this is limited to 32-96m.
sls_cfg_tip_locreset_location_radius: A location's surface is left alone while a player on the surface is within this distance of it. Only a player inside a dungeon holds back its interior.
sls_cfg_tip_locreset_location_buffer: How far beyond the ground a location reset touches a player build still holds it back. A dungeon held back this way still has its interior rebuilt.
sls_cfg_tip_locreset_refill_chests: Re-rolls the loot in chests nobody has built or placed. Off by default: it is the one refresh that grants new items.
sls_cfg_tip_locreset_biome_rate: Multiplies every reset timer in this biome: 0.5 resets twice as fast, 2 half as fast, 0 never resets there.
sls_cfg_tip_locreset_group_hours: Real-world hours between this group's resets. Left on the default until you move it.
sls_cfg_locreset_group_scheduled: Timed by the schedule '$1' in the YAML file.
sls_cfg_tip_locreset_group_terrain: Restores the ground around this group's targets as well as the objects themselves.
sls_cfg_desc_AutoTuneBiomeStarCaps: On the quick configure panel's Level Distribution page, scale each biome's star cap with the Max stars slider. Turn this off to type each biome's cap in yourself on that page.
sls_cfg_desc_BonemassNightSpawns: Allows the creatures that only spawn at night once Bonemass is defeated. In vanilla that is Skeletons across the Meadows, Black Forest, Swamp, Mountain and Plains. Turn off to stop them; any already out still leave at dawn. Nothing else the boss unlocks is affected.
sls_cfg_desc_BossEnemyDamageMultiplier: The amount of damage that each level gives a boss. 1 is 100% more damage per level.
sls_cfg_desc_BossEnemyHealthMultiplier: The amount of health that each level gives a boss. 1 is 100% more health per level.
sls_cfg_desc_ChanceBaseChancePerLevel: When using ChancePerLevel loot scaling, this is the base chance that any item will drop. Increased by the creatures level.
sls_cfg_desc_ChanceMajorModifier: The chance that a creature will have a major modifier (creatures can have BOTH major and minor modifiers).
sls_cfg_desc_ChanceMinorModifier: The chance that a creature will have a minor modifier (creatures can have BOTH major and minor modifiers).
sls_cfg_desc_ChanceOfBossModifier: The chance that a boss will have a boss modifier.
sls_cfg_desc_ChanceOfBossModifierOnCreat: The chance that a non-boss creature will have a boss modifier, up to MaxBossModifiersPerCreature.
sls_cfg_desc_ChanceOfMajorModifierOnBoss: The chance that a boss will have a major modifier.
sls_cfg_desc_ChanceOfMinorModifierOnBoss: The chance that a boss will have a minor modifier.
sls_cfg_desc_EikthyrNightSpawns: Allows the creatures that only spawn at night once Eikthyr is defeated. In vanilla that is Greydwarfs in the Meadows. Turn off to stop them; any already out still leave at dawn. Nothing else the boss unlocks is affected.
sls_cfg_desc_ElderNightSpawns: Allows the creatures that only spawn at night once The Elder is defeated. In vanilla that is Greydwarf brutes and shamans in the Meadows, and Draugr in fog across the Meadows, Black Forest, Mountain and Plains. Turn off to stop them; any already out still leave at dawn. Nothing else the boss unlocks is affected.
sls_cfg_desc_EnableCreatureScalingPerLev: Enables started creatures to get larger for each star
sls_cfg_desc_EnableDistanceLevelScalingB: Creatures further away from the center of the world have a higher chance to levelup, this is a bonus applied to existing creature/biome configuration.
sls_cfg_desc_EnableLocationReset: Master switch for the background Location Reset sweep, which restores looted locations, dungeons, ores, pickables and vegetation so they can be gathered again. Per-target opt-in lives in LocationResetSettings.yaml. Back up your world before enabling.
sls_cfg_desc_EnableMultiplayerEnemyDamag: Creatures gain more damage when players are grouped up.
sls_cfg_desc_EnableMultiplayerEnemyHealt: Creatures gain more health when players are grouped up.
sls_cfg_desc_EnableNemesisSystem: Enables the per-player Nemesis system that biases newly-spawning creature star levels based on a tracked player score.
sls_cfg_desc_EnableZoneScalingBonus: Divides the world into island-based zones. Zones gain levels from creature kills and apply bonus level-up chances to creatures that spawn inside them.
sls_cfg_desc_EnemyDamageLevelMultiplier: The amount of damage that each level gives a creatures, vanilla is 0.5x (eg 50% more damage each level).
sls_cfg_desc_EnemyHealthMultiplier: The amount of health that each level gives a creature, vanilla is 1x.
sls_cfg_desc_FaderNightSpawns: Allows the creatures that only spawn at night once Fader is defeated. None are known in vanilla, but other mods can add them. Turn off to stop them; any already out still leave at dawn. Nothing else the boss unlocks is affected.
sls_cfg_desc_LimitCreatureModifierPrefix: Maximum number of prefix names to use when building a creatures name.
sls_cfg_desc_LimitCreatureModifiersToCre: Limits the number of modifiers that a creature can have based on its level.
sls_cfg_desc_LocationResetSweepBudgetMs: Milliseconds of server frame time the reset sweep may consume per frame. This is the main throughput throttle: raise it to restore the world faster, lower it if the server is under strain. 0 uses the value from LocationResetSettings.yaml.
sls_cfg_desc_LootDropCalculationType: How loot amounts scale with level. PerLevel: amount scales linearly with level. Exponential: amount scales exponentially ((1 + PerLevelLootScale)^(level-1) for vanilla drop tables). ChancePerLevel: amounts scale linearly like PerLevel, and each sub-100% drop's chance to occur also grows with level (see PerLevelLootChanceScale).
sls_cfg_desc_LootEggsDropIncreaseStacks: This causes higher level chickens (and other egg producers) to drop MORE eggs instead of higher leveled ones.
sls_cfg_desc_MaxActiveRaids: The maximum number of concurrent raids, automatically limited to 1 per player.
sls_cfg_desc_MaxBossLevel: The Maximum number of stars that a boss creature can have. Applies wherever the boss stands: biome caps and conditional tiers do not change it, a CreatureMaxLevelOverride naming the boss does.
sls_cfg_desc_MaxBossModifiersPerBoss: The maximum number of boss modifiers that a boss can have.
sls_cfg_desc_MaxBossModifiersPerCreature: The maximum number of boss modifiers that a non-boss creature can have. 0 keeps boss modifiers to bosses.
sls_cfg_desc_MaxLevel: The Maximum number of stars that a creature can have. A biome's BiomeMaxLevelOverride or an active boss-conditional tier (LevelSettings.yaml) sets its own cap in place of this one, and bosses use MaxBossLevel.
sls_cfg_desc_MaxMajorModifiersPerBoss: The maximum number of major modifiers that a boss can have.
sls_cfg_desc_MaxMajorModifiersPerCreatur: The default number of major modifiers that a creature can have.
sls_cfg_desc_MaxMinorModifiersPerBoss: The maximum number of minor modifiers that a boss can have.
sls_cfg_desc_MaxMinorModifiersPerCreatur: The default number of minor modifiers that a creature can have.
sls_cfg_desc_MaxRaidAttemptsPerPlayer: The Maximum number of times to try to activate a raid for a given player. The available raids will be shuffled each time before rolling their activation chance. With 10 raids defined the randomly selected first X will get a chance to spawn.
sls_cfg_desc_MaximumCreatureScale: The largest scale multiplier a creature can grow to, counting its base size, size per star and size modifiers like Big together. 5 = five times its normal size. A creature's MaxSizeScale in LevelSettings.yaml replaces this for that creature.
sls_cfg_desc_MinorModifiersFirstInName: Enables or disables ordering of modifiers for naming. If enabled, minor modifiers will be sorted first eg: Fast Poisonous
sls_cfg_desc_ModerNightSpawns: Allows the creatures that only spawn at night once Moder is defeated. None are known in vanilla, but other mods can add them. Turn off to stop them; any already out still leave at dawn. Nothing else the boss unlocks is affected.
sls_cfg_desc_ModifierIconDisplayStyle: Style to display modifiers as on the creature HUD. Icons = detailed modifier icons, Stars = star-shaped modifier icons, None = plain default stars.
sls_cfg_desc_MultiplayerEnemyDamageModif: The additional amount of damage enemies will do to players, when there is a group of players together, per player. .2 = 20%. Vanilla gives creatures 4% more damage per player nearby.
sls_cfg_desc_MultiplayerEnemyHealthModif: Enemies take reduced damage when there is a group of players, vanilla gives creatures 30% damage resistance per player nearby.
sls_cfg_desc_MultiplayerScalingRequiredP: The number of players in a local area required to cause monsters to gain bonus health and/or damage.
sls_cfg_desc_PerLevelBirdLootScale: Per level additional loot that birds gain.
sls_cfg_desc_PerLevelDestructibleLootSca: The amount of additional loot that destructible items grant for each level
sls_cfg_desc_PerLevelLootChanceScale: Under the PerLevel and ChancePerLevel loot styles: additional chance per level that a sub-100% loot drop will occur, added on top of any per-drop ChanceScaleFactor. Under ChancePerLevel it also grows vanilla drop-table chances. E.g. 0.05 = +5% drop chance per level. Has no effect on drops with a base Chance of 1.
sls_cfg_desc_PerLevelLootScale: The amount of additional loot that a creature provides per each star level
sls_cfg_desc_PerLevelMineRockLootScale: The amount of additional stones and ores that each level grants for a rock
sls_cfg_desc_PerLevelScaleBonus: The size a creature gains each star level. Negative values shrink creatures each star, down to MinimumCreatureScale.
sls_cfg_desc_PerLevelTreeLootScale: The amount of additional wood that each level grants for a tree.
sls_cfg_desc_QueenNightSpawns: Allows the creatures that only spawn at night once The Queen is defeated. In vanilla that is Seekers, Seeker broods and Ticks across the Meadows, Black Forest, Mountain and Plains. Turn off to stop them; any already out still leave at dawn. Nothing else the boss unlocks is affected.
sls_cfg_desc_ScaleAllLootByLevel: Enables scaling of all loot which does not normally scale per level. Typically this is just trophies.
sls_cfg_desc_ServerTimeBetweenRaidStartC: Number of minutes between when the server will check to start raids (raids can still be on cooldown and will not be started).
sls_cfg_desc_YagluthNightSpawns: Allows the creatures that only spawn at night once Yagluth is defeated. In vanilla that is Fulings across the Meadows, Black Forest and Mountain. Turn off to stop them; any already out still leave at dawn. Nothing else the boss unlocks is affected.
sls_cfg_desc_CreatureLevelSettings_Enabl: Enables boss-reactive, biome-specific levelup chances based on the world's defeated bosses (global keys).
sls_cfg_desc_CreatureLevelSettings_BossL: Inline level generators whose expanded curve overwrites BossCreatureLevelUpChance on load. Merged with BossLevelupGeneratorRefs. A boss curve outranks the default, conditional and biome chances; a creature-specific entry naming that boss still wins.
sls_cfg_desc_BiomeSpecificSetting_BiomeM: Star cap for creatures in this biome, replacing MaxLevel here. Bosses use MaxBossLevel instead, and an active boss-conditional tier replaces this cap with its own range.
